title: IPC admin.status result
description: The read-only administrative view (capability `admin.status`, admin socket only): health, the full backend-neutral ConnectivitySummary — the raw detail ordinary data clients never see (ADR-0036) — this profile's PeerId, and bounded counters. Counters are drawn from observability.md's inventory; none carries a raw EndpointId or a payload byte.

events_dropped_total.description: Copies dropped from any client's session queue under the push-events overload rule (item 1, or a copy that could not queue), every session since the daemon started, closed ones included; monotonic. Omitted by a server that does not keep the count, never 0 in its place (LOCAL-IPC.md, admin.status, A 2026-11-04).

events_refused_total.description: Inbound broadcasts the ingress gate refused (over the publisher's rate or the profile's shared ingress rate, or while draining), one per refused message whatever the number of sessions on its channel, on any channel, held by a local session or not, since the daemon started; monotonic. A signal, never a count of distinct losses: a refused message leaves no dedup entry, so a republished copy that is refused counts again. Nothing a session queue drops moves it, and no refusal moves events_dropped_total. Since 1.2.0, served only on a connection that negotiated IPC 2.13 or later; below 2.13 the 1.1 block is served without it. From 2.13, omitted by a server that does not keep the count, never 0 in its place (LOCAL-IPC.md, admin.status, A 2026-11-10; ADR-0026 A 2026-11-10).

pre_auth.description: Pre-authentication admission counters, surfaced here and nowhere on the data socket. `tracked_peers` left this block at 1.1.0 (A 2026-10-01): never emitted by any build, removed under LOCAL-IPC.md's pre-release clause (ADR-0017); the ingress limiters' tracked peers are the `ingress` block's.

ingress.description: Post-authentication ingress rate state: the peers each limiter currently tracks (IngressLimiter::tracked_peers, one per lane). Admin socket only.
